reviewContext.issueReference: round-13-audit:feat/ai-capture@25b4e97901f2d4188a824c9fdd1be2ec8b266157 (base 0a35708); findings: function-capture-mesh-prism-touching-face, performance-cad-side-face-member-rescans, performance-capture-shared-profile-ancestry-rebuilds, maintainability-capture-touching-shell-mesh-eligibility; no GitHub issue; workflowInput.requestedOutcome is the issue body
reviewContext.userProblem: The round-13 audit found four defects in AI capture and 3D CAD pages. (1) A tall extrusion seated flush on a closed imported STL box gets a false picture-only interference pair, because the prism cap band (crates/capture/src/prism.rs:237) and the mesh edge band (mesh.rs:309-344) both claim the joint ray and the picture witness enters the report (interference.rs:585-597); --fail-on-interference exits 1. (2) Side-face membership is re-scanned per extrusion because R12-4 keys its scan budget and set by a fresh ExtrudeGeometry (packages/core/src/cad/history.ts:482), so K extrusions of an M-member outline cost M x K. (3) Capture re-normalizes contour ancestry for every whole-sketch extrusion of one shared loop array (packages/core/src/capture/scene.ts:494). (4) Rust closed_by and target_eligible reject welded edge-contact and face-contact STL shells (crates/capture/src/mesh.rs:61, nmesh.rs:257/266) that the CAD worker cuts, so the native CLI drops the cut with cad.body.missing and the desktop renderer treats the mesh as open.
requiredOutcomes: function-capture-mesh-prism-touching-face (R13-1; car13-p1, car13-p5): the raster and reference renderer drop a picture witness whose conservative body boxes (lattice::body_boxes, moved from interference.rs:325-339) share no positive extent (lattice::shares_extent, strictly > 0.0). The tall flush fixture gives zero pairs and zero candidates with RGB equal to the overlay-disabled render in front and back views; the 0.01 mm penetration keeps one (0,1) pair. Natively the tall contact exits 0 with PNG equal to --no-interference, and the penetration exits 1.

performance-cad-side-face-member-rescans (R13-2; car13-p2): side queries use memberIndices through history.typed. A whole-profile query is one has (sideMemberVisits === K for K extrusions). An explicit selection builds a lazy per-tool Set<CadLoop> (sideSelectionEntries) with at most 3 visits per query. Omitted-loop lines give cad.reference.missing, frames are unchanged, R12-4 stays for PCB tools and unregistered tools, and the ordinary 500-feature fixture has zero side work.

performance-capture-shared-profile-ancestry-rebuilds (R13-3; car13-p3): a walk-local cache keyed by loop-array identity, admitted only for whole-sketch extrusions with prepared + searched >= PROFILE_CACHE_MIN_WORK (4096). The slanted-rim N=1024 and sparse high-vertex fixtures give equal ancestry work and prepared coordinates for K=32 and K=1, with admitted 1 and hits 31. Scene bytes equal the oracle. Explicit subsets do no cache work. The ordinary fixture has 0 lookups, admissions and hits, with 5000/5500/0 unchanged and maxDirectWork * 4 <= 4096.

maintainability-capture-touching-shell-mesh-eligibility (R13-4; car13-p4a, p4b, p4c, p5): Rust mesh_contact::contact_closed implements the R12-6 C1-C5 checks on bit-exact NMESH-grid integers with checked i128 arithmetic. closed_by delegates to it on a third edge use, and target_eligible is contact-aware by edge-group size with C6 emptiness. The nine fixtures match the TS decoder, off-grid raw meshes return false without a panic, and welded_edge_contact_is_closed passes. Native top-view captures of the three welded fixtures show background through the hole at (2,2,10), material at the same point in the uncut twin, and open === false.
nonGoals: No change to prism.rs, mesh.rs volume and facet rules, shading, the lattice analysis, report types, CLI flags, Tauri, MCP, NCS1 or goldens.
No change to the ExtrudeGeometry type, history.ts:579 array reuse, construction.ts, loop-forest.ts, cad-request.ts or the R12-3 fallback budget.
No TypeScript decoder change, no docs edits, no design-doc edits by workers, and no new dependency.
constraints: AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, strict typing, noUncheckedIndexedAccess-safe reads without non-null assertions, Biome clean on touched files, CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true, and packages/io must not import @nodetto/core.

artifactRoots are exactly ["target", "tmp/cad3d"]. Evidence goes under tmp/car13-r13/<planId>/. Each plan uses CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/car13-<plan>. No *.test.ts or *.test.tsx file may be left under target/ or tmp/.

Per-plan gates are focused. bun run typecheck, bun run lint, mise run verify and the release parity plus MCP run happen once at integration. welded_edge_contact_is_closed fails until p4b. p1 therefore runs the full crate with -- --skip welded_edge_contact_is_closed (stricter than design 30.2, because p1 changes code covered by the crate integration tests), and p4a uses --lib mesh_contact.
Shared files are chained: lib.rs (p4a then p4b) and nmesh.rs (p4a then p4c). Workers follow the SHA-256 pre/post hash and drift-stop rule of car13-00-overview.md.
The 26.2 timing rule applies. Work counters only. At most two bun test or cargo test processes at once. Never relax existing assertions, except the specified nmesh.rs:532 replacement.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R13-1 filters picture witnesses by conservative body boxes with a strict zero threshold instead of aligning the tolerance bands.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Disjoint boxes prove zero shared volume, the check is exact and cheap, and every positive-extent thin penetration keeps its witness.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R13-2 reads the sketch through history.typed and the existing memberIndices, with a per-tool selected-loop set for explicit selections.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The ExtrudeGeometry type is unchanged, work is linear in queries plus the selection input, and the ordinary path adds nothing.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R13-3 admits on prepared + searched >= 4096, for whole-sketch extrusions only, with a lazy walk-local map.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Searched units alone miss sparse high-vertex profiles. Ordinary profiles cost at most about 775, so ordinary documents do no cache work.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R13-4 puts the contact path in a new mesh_contact.rs, registered under cfg(test) in p4a and for production in p4b together with its caller.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Each gate passes independently under -D warnings, the closed_by fast path stays allocation-free, and the TS and Rust implementations stay independent.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R13-5 proves the welded cut with a through-hole pixel, an uncut twin and adjacent material samples.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Image inequality alone passes when only the plate is cut.

intentionalTradeoffs: The Rust tall fixture is the on-grid raw mesh with probed default-fit camera literals, because Rust has no STL reader; the real import is covered natively.
The 0.01 mm penetration in Rust asserts the pair, not a visible hatch.
Shared whole profiles under 4096 admission units still normalize once per tool, bounded at under 4096 units per tool.
R13-4 is split into three chained plans. car13-p5 replaces car12-p7 and carries R12-7.
supportedEdgeCases: Flush mesh and prism contact on each world axis; thin 0.01 mm penetration; empty body boxes.
Whole-profile, explicit-selection and omitted-loop side queries; PCB and unregistered tools on the R12-4 path.
Shared slanted-rim and sparse high-vertex profiles; explicit subsets; the ordinary 500-feature document.
Edge, face and crossed-diagonal welded contacts; separated shells; open triangle, unbalanced edge, welded overlap, double-sided fin and coincident shells; off-grid and overflow-scale inputs.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Oblique, partial or rotated contacts whose boxes overlap; other named views.
Boa latency, native peak memory, allocator bytes, desktop WebGL and frame time, Tauri IPC, MCP delivery and cross-platform byte determinism.

acceptanceCriteria: cadGeometryWork gains sideSelectionEntries. Side queries on a history cad.extrude with a valid profile use memberIndices: a whole profile (tool.loops === profile.loops) costs one visit and no allocation; an explicit selection builds one lazy Set<CadLoop> per tool and costs 1 + inspected indices per query. Everything else uses the unchanged R12-4 path.

The shared whole-profile checkCadPage test at M = K = 256/512/1024 gives sideMemberVisits === K with no builds and no entries, and fails before the fix. The explicit-selection test gives K cad.reference.missing errors naming the rectangle line, sideSelectionEntries === K, no builds and visits <= 16K. Frames equal faceFrame.
The ordinary 500-feature check has zero side visits, builds and entries. The existing side tests (history.test.ts:582-713) pass unedited.

normaliseToolLoops accepts an optional work {prepared, searched}: prepared is the sum of loop.points.length (0 on the early return), searched is the local work counter. The fallback budget is unchanged. PROFILE_CACHE_MIN_WORK = 4096 is exported. CaptureWalkStats gains optional profileCache {lookups, admitted, hits, prepared, maxDirectWork}.

buildCadCaptureModel caches only whole-sketch extrusions, by loop-array identity, in a lazily created walk-local map, admitting when prepared + searched >= 4096. Other tools normalize directly. Per-tool charge, makeTool, bounds and bytes are unchanged.

Slanted-rim N=1024 and sparse high-vertex fixtures: K=32 equals K=1 in ancestry totals, forestFallbacks and prepared, with admitted 1, lookups 31 and hits 31 (fails before the fix). K=32 scene bytes equal the oracle. Explicit subsets give 0/0/0 cache counts and keep their own ancestry.

The ordinary 500-feature guard gives lookups, admitted and hits 0, ancestorProbes 5000, indexEntries 5500, forestFallbacks 0 and maxDirectWork * 4 <= PROFILE_CACHE_MIN_WORK. Existing scene tests pass unedited.
